def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """
    Greedy placement (sort by req_rate/slo desc, place on GPU minimizing
    resulting KVPR), then a two-stage local search: first best-improvement
    moves/swaps involving the hottest GPU, then a full all-pairs move/swap
    search, each applied while it lowers the maximum KVPR across GPUs.
    """

    sorted_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True)
    # Secondary seed: place large models first for better memory packing
    alt_sorted = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.model_size, reverse=True)

    placement = {gpu_id: [] for gpu_id in range(gpu_num)}
    free_mem = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    pressure = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted_models:
        best_idx, best_key = None, None
        for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
            rem = free_mem[gpu_id] - model.model_size
            if rem > 0:
                kvpr = (pressure[gpu_id] + model.req_rate / model.slo) / rem
                # tie-break: prefer more remaining memory for future flexibility
                key = (kvpr, -rem)
                if best_key is None or key < best_key:
                    best_key, best_idx = key, gpu_id

        if best_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Cannot fit model of size {model.model_size} GB")

        placement[best_idx].append(model)
        pressure[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
        free_mem[best_idx] -= model.model_size

    # Local search: best-improvement moves and swaps involving the hottest GPU
    def kvpr(g, p=None, f=None):
        p = pressure[g] if p is None else p
        f = free_mem[g] if f is None else f
        return p / f if f > 0 else float('inf')

    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        hot = max(range(gpu_num), key=kvpr)
        current_max = kvpr(hot)
        best = None  # (new_max, action, params)

        for m1 in list(placement[hot]):
            p1, s1 = m1.req_rate / m1.slo, m1.model_size
            # candidate moves
            for dst in range(gpu_num):
                if dst == hot or s1 > free_mem[dst]:
                    continue
                new_dst = kvpr(dst, pressure[dst] + p1, free_mem[dst] - s1)
                new_hot = kvpr(hot, pressure[hot] - p1, free_mem[hot] + s1)
                cand = max(new_dst, new_hot)
                if cand < current_max and (best is None or cand < best[0]):
                    best = (cand, 'move', m1, dst, None)
            # candidate swaps
            for dst in range(gpu_num):
                if dst == hot:
                    continue
                for m2 in placement[dst]:
                    p2, s2 = m2.req_rate / m2.slo, m2.model_size
                    if s1 - s2 > free_mem[dst] or s2 - s1 > free_mem[hot]:
                        continue
                    new_hot = kvpr(hot, pressure[hot] - p1 + p2, free_mem[hot] - s1 + s2)
                    new_dst = kvpr(dst, pressure[dst] - p2 + p1, free_mem[dst] - s2 + s1)
                    cand = max(new_hot, new_dst)
                    if cand < current_max and (best is None or cand < best[0]):
                        best = (cand, 'swap', m1, dst, m2)

        if best:
            _, kind, m1, dst, m2 = best
            p1, s1 = m1.req_rate / m1.slo, m1.model_size
            if kind == 'move':
                placement[hot].remove(m1)
                placement[dst].append(m1)
                pressure[hot] -= p1; free_mem[hot] += s1
                pressure[dst] += p1; free_mem[dst] -= s1
            else:
                p2, s2 = m2.req_rate / m2.slo, m2.model_size
                placement[hot].remove(m1); placement[hot].append(m2)
                placement[dst].remove(m2); placement[dst].append(m1)
                pressure[hot] += p2 - p1; free_mem[hot] += s2 - s1
            pressure[dst] += p1 - p2; free_mem[dst] += s1 - s2
            improved = True

    # Stage 2: full all-pairs local search (moves and swaps between any GPUs)
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        cur = max(kvpr(g) for g in range(gpu_num))

        for src in range(gpu_num):

                for dst in range(gpu_num):

                        cand = max(kvpr(src, pressure[src] - p1, free_mem[src] + s1),
                                   kvpr(dst, pressure[dst] + p1, free_mem[dst] - s1),
                                   max(kvpr(g) for g in range(gpu_num) if g not in (src, dst)))
                        if cand < cur and (best is None or cand < best[0]):
                            best = (cand, 'move', src, dst, m1, None)
                    for m2 in list(placement[dst]):
                        p2, s2 = m2.req_rate / m2.slo, m2.model_size
                        if s1 - s2 > free_mem[dst] or s2 - s1 > free_mem[src]:

                        cand = max(kvpr(src, pressure[src] - p1 + p2, free_mem[src] - s1 + s2),

                                   max(kvpr(g) for g in range(gpu_num) if g not in (src, dst)))
                        if cand < cur and (best is None or cand < best[0]):

        if best:

    """
    Multi-start greedy + local search. For several model orderings

    minimizing resulting KVPR, then refine with best-improvement move/swap
    local search that lowers the maximum KVPR. Return the best placement.
    """

    def kvpr(p, f):
        return p / f if f > 0 else float('inf')

    def build(order):
        placement = {g: [] for g in range(gpu_num)}
        free_mem = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
        pressure = [0.0] * gpu_num
        for model in order:
            best_idx, best_k = None, float('inf')
            for g in range(gpu_num):
                rem = free_mem[g] - model.model_size
                if rem > 0:
                    k = (pressure[g] + model.req_rate / model.slo) / rem
                    if k < best_k:
                        best_k, best_idx = k, g
            if best_idx is None:
                return None
            placement[best_idx].append(model)
            pressure[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
            free_mem[best_idx] -= model.model_size
        return placement, free_mem, pressure

    def refine(placement, free_mem, pressure):
        def max_k():
            return max(kvpr(pressure[g], free_mem[g]) for g in range(gpu_num))
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            cur = max_k()
            best = None
            for src in range(gpu_num):
                for model in placement[src]:
                    pm = model.req_rate / model.slo
                    for dst in range(gpu_num):
                        if dst == src or model.model_size > free_mem[dst]:
                            continue
                        new = max(kvpr(pressure[src] - pm, free_mem[src] + model.model_size),
                                  kvpr(pressure[dst] + pm, free_mem[dst] - model.model_size))
                        cand = max(new, max(kvpr(pressure[g], free_mem[g])
                                            for g in range(gpu_num) if g not in (src, dst)))
                        if cand < cur and (best is None or cand < best[0]):
                            best = (cand, 'move', src, dst, model)
            for src in range(gpu_num):
                for dst in range(src + 1, gpu_num):
                    for m1 in placement[src]:
                        for m2 in placement[dst]:
                            if m1.model_size - m2.model_size > free_mem[dst] or \
                               m2.model_size - m1.model_size > free_mem[src]:
                                continue
                            p1, p2 = m1.req_rate / m1.slo, m2.req_rate / m2.slo
                            new = max(
                                kvpr(pressure[src] - p1 + p2, free_mem[src] - m1.model_size + m2.model_size),
                                kvpr(pressure[dst] - p2 + p1, free_mem[dst] - m2.model_size + m1.model_size))
                            cand = max(new, max(kvpr(pressure[g], free_mem[g])
                                                for g in range(gpu_num) if g not in (src, dst)))
                            if cand < cur and (best is None or cand < best[0]):

                    free_mem[src] += payload.model_size
                    pressure[dst] += payload.req_rate / payload.slo
                    free_mem[dst] -= payload.model_size
                else:
